responsibility: Coordinate several agents on one Rhino 9 model: per-owner files, a set-out the coordinator writes first and reissues on change, notes in the model, and a check across the files each round.
inputs: The agent's own open Rhino 9 document reached through a run_python tool, the shared folder the user names, and the other agents' files there as last saved. Load project context only when the task needs project records.

modes.when: Only the coordinator's team check report in the shared folder (reports/round-<n>.json), and saving the agent's own model file in place.
